title: A cold day
instructions: Kim soğuk bir günü anlatıyor. Kısa bir metin; giydiklerine dikkat et.

script.speaker: kim
script.text: Today it is very cold. It is minus two degrees.

script.speaker: kim
script.text: I am wearing a big coat, a hat and gloves.

script.speaker: kim
script.text: My brother is not wearing a hat. His ears are red!

questions.feedback: Kaban, şapka ve eldiven giyiyor; atkıdan bahsetmiyor.
questions.evidence: I am wearing a big coat, a hat and gloves.

questions.prompt: Why are her brother's ears red?
options: He is not wearing a hat.
